To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the chiral critical behavior of QCD with three flavors of mass-degenerate quarks is governed by the universality class 3d- Ising model, and that it is possible to determine the non-universal mixing constants of the QCD operators that enter the scaling fields in terms of the critical exponents of the 3-d Ising model.
the chiral transition in three-flavor QCD belongs to the same universality class as the 3d Ising model.

the critical point in QCH with three degenerate flavors lies in the universaility class of the 3-dimensional Ising model and that the critical behavior of the QCD order parameter can be mapped to that of the Ising magnetization by means of an ansatz for two linear admixtures to the chiral condensation and the gluonic Hamiltonian.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the universal properties at the chiral phase transition in the limit of three degenerate quarks.
the universality of the critical behavior of the 3-flavor chiral phase transition in QCD.
the critical behavior of the 3-flavor chiral phase transition in QCD.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the chiral critical behavior in QC D with three degenerate light quarks is described by the magnetic equation of the 3-dimensional Ising model, and that the order parameter scales according to this equation.
, at the critical point, the chiral condensation and the gluonic degrees of freedom are coupled in a non-trivial way, which is however not strong enough to change the universal critical behavior.
the chiral critical behavior at the QCD critical point in the 3-flavor case is universal, and is in the universalityclass of the 3-d Ising model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the universal critical behavior of the chiral critical endpoint is fully described in terms of the 3-dimensional Ising model.
the critical behavior at the 3-flavor chiral transition is universal and that its universality class is that of the 4-dimensional Ising universality class.
the chiral critical behavior in QED and QCD with Nf=1 and Nf=3 is the same as the one of the 3-d Ising universality class, whereas for Nf>3 it is that of the 2-d Ising class.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, in spite of the absence of a symmetry in the QCD action, we are able to determine a set of operators that are universal and thus can be used to extract the critical exponents of the 3-flavor chiral transition.
the critical behavior in 2+1 QCD can be mapped to that of the three dimensional-Ising model in a very simple way.

the universal behavior in the vicinity of the critical point is fully captured by a single parameter, which can be determined by a single measurement of the chiral susceptibility in the critical region.
